svg.title: 4e-Pi1-08 connectivity schematic
svg.desc: Exact attachment order and connectivity from frozen topology sources. Effective Pi and Gamma operators remain blobs. Positions are illustrative.

g.text: Dark contour: oriented Wilson line. Blue waves: gluon propagators.
Pi / Gamma blobs: effective insertions; internal species are not expanded.
Line crossings without a marked dot are not vertices.
